description: Source code implementing quantized matrix multiplication and bias broadcasting functions using oneDNN within the at::native::onednn namespace.

classes.name: ScaleSpec
classes.description: Defines how to configure oneDNN scales, including mask, groups, and data type, with helper functions for normalization and expected element count.

methods.name: broadcast_bias2D
methods.description: Broadcasts a 1D or 2D bias tensor to match the target shape for matrix multiplication.

methods.name: broadcast_bias3D
methods.description: Broadcasts a 1D or 3D bias tensor to match the target shape for batched matrix multiplication.

methods.name: broadcast_bias
methods.description: Chooses between 2D and 3D bias broadcasting based on destination tensor dimensions.

methods.name: quantized_matmul
methods.description: Performs quantized matrix multiplication with optional bias and post-processing, utilizing oneDNN primitives.

methods.name: scaled_matmul
methods.description: Performs scaled matrix multiplication on GPU with support for different scaling types and optional bias.
